entries.decision: Make the loader a generator that yields each configured source as it reads it.
alternatives: Collect every source into a list and return the list after the loop ends.
entries.why: A generator holds one source in memory at a time.
entries.result: Written, and not yet run against the loader suite.

entries.decision: Collect every configured source into a list and return the list after the loop ends.
alternatives: Keep the generator and change each caller to iterate it.
entries.why: Three callers index the result and read its length, so a generator breaks them, and the ticket's allowed changes do not include the callers.

entries.decision: Keep the loader's exported signature as it is.
entries.why: No caller needs a new argument, so a change would only widen the diff.
